capabilities: Render vault projects as a 3D city with districts, lenses, and filters
Launch AI coding agents in a terminal with generated project context
Show read-only Git activity (commits, branch, conflicts) per project
Write AGENTS.md and heartbeat hooks so agents report session status
Inspect projects with dependency, quest, and attention panels
extras: Desktop-only; a vault mode disables the agent layer entirely and the plugin claims to make no network requests. A paid standalone app (Hypernovum Pro) is advertised separately. Full frontmatter field reference is in SCHEMA.md outside the README.
problem: Obsidian gives no spatial overview of project status across notes and no way to see, brief, or launch coding agents from inside the vault.
